phase: Phase D3 - extended Kalman filter and Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoother beside the SR-UKF and BLS-LM
written: 2026-10-30, before any D3 comparison number was computed (only the unit tests of tests/test_ekf_smoother.py had run)
authorisation: owner chose the smoother + EKF track on 2026-10-30 ('smoother + EKF ... basla'); no frozen file is edited: the EKF lives in the new module src/lunar_od/ekf.py

design.ekf: run_lunar_ekf in src/lunar_od/ekf.py. Same inputs as run_lunar_ukf. The measurement function, measurement noise, residual (angle wrapping), bias-state layout and process-noise coercion/discretisation are the UKF's own helpers from filters.py. Time update: mean by propagate_augmented_state, covariance Phi P Phi^T + Q (Q added after propagation, as in the UKF). Measurement Jacobian: central difference of the shared measurement function (steps 1 m, 1e-3 m/s, 1 for bias states). Joseph-form update.
design.smoother: rts_smooth: fixed-interval RTS over the stored filtered/predicted states, covariances and STMs; gain C_k = P_k|k Phi^T (P_k+1|k)^-1 by a linear solve.
design.not_in_scope: K_SRP solve-for, state freezing, adaptive Q/R, robust updates, iterated EKF, two-way range (the UKF does not support it either), scenario-config and desktop wiring

configuration.arc: synthetic, the SR-UKF test fixture extended to one hour: lunar orbit at 100 km altitude, Moon point mass only (mu_earth = mu_sun = 0), observation epochs every 60 s from 0 to 3600 s, three synthetic stations (lat/lon 0/0, 0/90, 45/-30), identity Earth-fixed frame, Earth at the Moon centre; truth by propagate_augmented_state at rtol 1e-12 / atol 1e-13
measurements: range_rate (range 1 m, range-rate 1e-4 m/s, az/el 1e-5 rad)
configuration.noise: zero-mean Gaussian at the station sigmas; one realisation per seed shared by all estimators
configuration.prior: x_guess = truth(0) + N(0, P0), P0 = diag(sigma_r^2 I3, sigma_v^2 I3); the same x_guess and P0 for every estimator; BLS-LM gets P0 as prior_covariance
configuration.seeds: 50 per (measurement, prior scale): numpy default_rng([20261030, measurement_index, scale_index, seed])
configuration.estimators: EKF (final epoch), SR-UKF alpha 0.35 (final epoch), EKF+RTS (first epoch), BLS-LM with prior (first epoch, max_iter 60, return_posterior); all at rtol 1e-12 / atol 1e-13, process noise none

gates.G1_linear_oracle: tests/test_ekf_smoother.py: on a linear-Gaussian model the RTS smoother equals the stacked batch MAP solution (states <= 1e-8, covariances rtol 1e-8) with and without process noise, and the filter's last state equals the MAP last state
gates.G2_invariance: no existing source file changes; the full pytest suite has no new failure
gates.G3_linear_regime_agreement: S20m, both measurements, every seed: |x_EKF - x_UKF| <= 0.1 sigma_UKF per component at the final epoch, and |x_RTS - x_BLS| <= 0.1 sigma_BLS per component at the first epoch
gates.G4_consistency: S20m, both measurements: the mean NEES over 50 seeds of EKF, SR-UKF, EKF+RTS and BLS-LM each lies in [4.39, 7.61] (6 +- 3.29 sqrt(12/50), the 99.9% band of the mean of 50 chi-square(6))

reported_not_gated: S2km and S20km: position and velocity RMS error, mean NEES, mean NIS, failures (exceptions, non-finite), per estimator; runtime per estimator; the expectation, not a gate, is that the single-pass EKF and RTS lose consistency first as the prior grows, the SR-UKF later, and the iterated BLS-LM not at all
decision_rule: D3_QUALIFIED if G1-G4 all PASS; otherwise D3_NOT_QUALIFIED with each failure reported as computed
